newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BankAmerica to advise Taiwan power project.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica to advise Taiwan power project.

text.p: Bank of America has been appointed financial advisor for a NT$18 billion (US$650 million) gas turbine project in Taiwan, the company said on Wednesday.
The 2X450 megawatt combined cycle gas turbine independent power project is in Taiwan's Taoyan County.

The project company, Ever Power IPP Co, is 53 percent owned by Ever Fortune Industrial Co, 25 percent by Marubeni Corp, 10 percent by Taiwan state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp, 10 percent by Chiao Tung Bank and two percent by Sinon Corp.

The plant will be located along the coast in the Keng Tze Kou section of Lu Chu Township, Taoyuan County. Construction is expected to begin in April 1997 with commercial operation scheduled for July 1999.
The project company will enter into a power sale and purchase agreement with Taiwan Power Co, the state-run power utility company, for a period of 25 years.
Gas for the power generation will be supplied by Chinese Petroleum Corp through a similar tenor fuel supply agreement.
